title: A Phase 2b trial of the efficacy and safety of semaglutide depot (CAM2056) in obesity or overweight
official: A Phase 2b, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial Assessing the Efficacy and Safety of Semaglutide Subcutaneous Depot (CAM2056) in People with Obesity or Overweight
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate superiority of the CAM2056 20 mg arm compared to placebo in reduction of body weight

interventions.name: Comparator for CAM2056 10 mg/ml and 20 mg/ml

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Man or woman, ≥18 years old (at the time of providing informed consent).
2. BMI at screening ≥30 kg/m2, or ≥27 kg/m2 to <30 kg/m2 with the presence of at least one of the following weight-related comorbidities (treated or untreated): hypertension, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, or cardiovascular disease.
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of T1D or T2D.
2. HbA1c ≥6.5% (or ≥48 mmol/mol) at screening.
3. Current eating disorder (anorexia, bulimia, or binge eating disorder).
4. A self-reported change in body weight >5 kg within 90 days before screening irrespective of medical records.
5. History or presence of chronic pancreatitis.
6. Personal or first-degree relative(s) with history of multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2, pancreatic cancer, or medullary thyroid carcinoma.
7. Treatment with blood glucose-lowering agents (including metformin) within 90 days before screening.
8. Treatment with a GLP-1RA within 90 days before screening.
